Theme

kerb noun

also curb, kerbstone, edge of the pavement

classical

Liv. 41.27 (Lewis & Short s.v. marginō): roads to be edged, marginandae
Levi–Bini p. 40: marciapiede, margō (viae)

margō, marginis m.

noun, third declension

edge, border; the kerb of a road

The edge of anything (Lewis & Short); Livy speaks of roads to be edged, marginandae (41.27, cited by Lewis & Short s.v. marginō). Levi and Bini give margō viae for the pavement itself, and viam margināre for laying one. Masculine or feminine; written masculine here, as in edge.

Other words

  • margō crepīdinis — the edge of the pavement

    also used · modern · Andresian p. 41

  • crepīdō viāria

    also used · modern · Traupman 299: curb; Traupman 299

    Traupman gives the same phrase for the pavement (379); see pavement.

See also pavement, road, edge.
